name: jag-insight
description: AI quota and usage monitor for Antigravity IDE and Visual Studio Code

commands.title: JAG Insights: Install Claude Code Usage Capture

jagInsights.enabled.description: Enable or disable JAG Insights status bar item.

jagInsights.pollIntervalMs.description: Polling interval in milliseconds to check local quota.

jagInsights.showUserEmail.description: Display user email in the status bar tooltip and details panel.

jagInsights.showPromptCredits.description: Display total prompt credits in status bar tooltip and details panel.

jagInsights.showQuotaOnStatusBar.description: Show integrated quota percentages (AG, CX, CL) directly on the status bar text.

jagInsights.statusBarFormat.description: Format template. Placeholders: {ag} (Antigravity Gemini), {agcx} (Antigravity Codex), {agcl}/{cl} (Antigravity Claude), {cx} (Codex), {cc} (Claude Code).

jagInsights.claudeCodeUsagePath.description: Path to the Claude Code rate-limit cache written by the JAG Insights statusLine capture.

jagInsights.claudeCodeStatePath.description: Optional legacy Claude Code monitor state file.

jagInsights.codexSessionPath.description: Optional Codex sessions directory. Empty automatically uses $CODEX_HOME/sessions or ~/.codex/sessions.

jagInsights.codexStatePath.description: Optional legacy Codex monitor state file path (선택 사항). 세션 데이터를 가져올 수 없을 때의 백업용 파일입니다.

jagInsights.geminiSessionPath.description: Optional Gemini CLI sessions directory. Empty automatically uses ~/.gemini/sessions. Gemini CLI 세션 JSONL 디렉터리 경로입니다.
